title: Universal optimality of the triangular lattice
description: The energy of point configurations of density one in the plane and the linear programming bound: a function below the interaction with nonnegative Fourier transform bounds the energy of every configuration from below, and the bound is the energy of the triangular lattice exactly when the function has contacts at the lattice and the dual lattice. Completely monotone interactions as positive mixtures of exponentials, and the passage from Gaussians to all of them. These are the first and the last step of OpenAI's proof (2026) that the triangular lattice is universally optimal. The construction in between begins with the sine product, the cardinal functions and their Fourier transforms after Gaussian damping, which reduce the problem to a linear system for two lists of numbers and two sign conditions; the solution of the system and the sign conditions are not yet in the course.
